rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say that you are dissatisfied, whether with a situation or with something specific.

example.english: I am dissatisfied with this service.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 fuk6 mou6 m4 mun5 ji3

rows.note: Use this when dissatisfaction is mainly expressed as personal unhappiness rather than criticism of a particular thing.

example.english: I was dissatisfied after losing the match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 syu1 zo2 coeng4 bo1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the dissatisfaction specifically comes from disappointment because expectations were not met.

example.english: I was dissatisfied because the restaurant promised a gift but did not give us one.
example.traditional: 間餐廳話會送禮物，點知冇，我好失望。
example.jyutping: gaan1 caan1 teng1 waa6 wui5 sung3 lai5 mat6 dim2 zi1 mou5 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6

rows.note: Use this more formal alternative when expressing dissatisfaction with a service, decision, quality, or other specific matter.

example.english: I expressed that I was dissatisfied with this decision.
example.traditional: 我對呢項決定表示不滿。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 hong6 kyut3 ding6 biu2 si6 bat1 mun5
